Series · Techstrong

The Inevitability Curve

A 20-episode Techstrong conversation series hosted by Chris Blask, following long arcs in technology, security, institutions, policy, communications, risk, and the futures already exerting pressure on the present.

Hosted by Chris Blask · 20 episodes · 2025

Series at source ↗

About the name

A longer line

Chris Blask recalls first using the term The Inevitability Curve around 1991–1992 while arguing that universal Internet connectivity was already an inevitable future state whose path could be anticipated from the present. The immediate practical conclusion was to build a firewall. This is first-person recollection; documentary verification of the earliest use remains pending.

Publication dates for the Techstrong series remain 2025 dates; the recollection is preserved as lineage, not as a backdated media artifact.
